Adobe DNG SDK in mpainter
=========================

This product includes DNG technology under license by Adobe.

What this folder is
-------------------
Part of the Adobe DNG SDK 1.7.1, build 2802 (November 10, 2026), used by mpainter's DNG plugin
(src/plugins/dng). The SDK is licensed under the DNG SDK License Agreement in LICENSE.txt, which
is the LICENSE.txt of the SDK package, unchanged. The DNG Specification patent license is on
https://helpx.adobe.com/camera-raw/digital-negative.html ("DNG Specification patent license").

Downloaded from https://www.adobe.com/go/dng_sdk, which led to
  https://download.adobe.com/pub/adobe/dng/dng_sdk_1_7_1_2802_20261110.zip
  80,525,157 bytes, SHA-256 e9bb04e956da3605d8ef4f821bdb979a250c22546b0332b7f81a93b11da7cceb

What was taken from the package
-------------------------------
  source/   = dng_sdk/source/ (all 159 files). mpainter does not build dng_validate.cpp (the
              command-line tool), dng_xmp_sdk.cpp (needs the XMP SDK) or dng_update_meta.cpp
              (rewrites metadata in place; needs the XMP SDK).
  libjpeg/  = the library files of libjpeg 9c from the package's libjpeg/ folder, and its README
              (the Independent JPEG Group's license terms are in that README). The command-line
              programs, build files and test images were left out. No libjpeg file was changed.
  LICENSE.txt = the package's LICENSE.txt.

Not taken: the XMP SDK, libjxl (mpainter uses libjxl from vcpkg, the same one as its JPEG XL
plugin), the project files, the documentation and the sample files.

Changes made for mpainter
-------------------------
mpainter builds the SDK without the XMP SDK (qDNGUseXMP=0). Two places in the SDK did not build
that way, so they were put inside #if qDNGUseXMP. Both are marked in the source with the comment
"mpainter modification".

  source/dng_jxl.cpp
    1. Writing the XMP box of a JPEG XL file (in the encoder). mpainter never writes DNG or JPEG XL
       files, so nothing is lost.
    2. Reading the XMP box of a JPEG XL file into the decoder's info. Without the XMP SDK, the XMP
       of such a file is ignored, like the XMP of any other DNG.

No other file was changed. Build settings are in the top-level CMakeLists.txt (target mp_dng_sdk).
